tasks.description: Confirm supply order (paints, brushes) with primary and backup supplier.
Confirm venue booking and secure backup location.
Review and update insurance coverage for cannabis compliance and participant safety.
Draft and schedule pre-event survey to gather dietary restrictions & allergies.
Send reminder email to guests (48 hours prior) with event details, safety guidelines, and waiver.
Test all technical equipment (projector, speakers) 1 hour before start.
Set up check-in station with tickets, name tags, and welcome materials.
Prepare and display painting materials with clear safety guidelines.
Ensure first aid kit and spill cleanup materials are readily accessible.
Facilitate the 3-hour painting session per the minute-by-minute agenda.
Manage breaks, refreshments, and maintain a welcoming atmosphere.
Collect and inventory all remaining materials, noting any shortages.
Distribute feedback survey link to all guests via email.
Clean and restore the venue to its original condition.
Review all risk probabilities and update mitigation plans for future events.
